label: preparing
what: Innkeeper and local tradespeople are jointly preparing an evening great-hall meeting and presentation, with bread for attendees financed through Freight's grain loan and Builder's collateral. The appointment specifies advance preparation access and my arrival precisely at eighteen. The initial private committee discussion and presentation suggest a surprise for my fortieth year as mayor, but that purpose remains unconfirmed. Secretary knowingly assists scheduling and communication; I have approved access and financed grain without knowing the full purpose. Neighbour reported overhearing preparations, but knowing participation is not established.
